headline: BCEAO Monetary Policy Committee Schedules Fourth Ordinary Meeting for 2026
summary: The Central Bank of West African States (BCEAO) has scheduled its fourth ordinary meeting of the Monetary Policy Committee for December 2, 2026, in Senegal.
why: The BCEAO sets monetary policy for the West African Economic and Monetary Union (UEMOA). Decisions made at these meetings regarding interest rates and liquidity impact the regional currency (CFA franc) and inflation.
